title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject a PDU session modification request.

entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: IE indicating the reason for session management related actions.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: IE containing protocol configuration options including PS data off status.

entities.name: Emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition where PDU session is established for emergency services.

entities.name: PDU session inactive
entities.description: Condition where PDU session is in inactive state at SMF.

entities.name: Message exempted from DNN based congestion
entities.description: Condition where AMF indicates message was exempted from DNN congestion control.

entities.name: Message exempted from S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion
entities.description: Condition where AMF indicates message was exempted from S-NSSAI and DNN congestion control.

entities.name: Message exempted from S-NSSAI only based congestion
entities.description: Condition where AMF indicates message was exempted from S-NSSAI only congestion control.

entities.name: No 3GPP PS data off UE status indicated
entities.description: Condition where Extended protocol configuration options IE does not indicate PS data off status.

entities.name: SMF rejects PDU session modification request
entities.description: Behavior where SMF rejects the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure.

relations.description: UE-requested PDU session modification procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message may contain 5GSM cause IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains Extended protocol configuration options IE.
If PDU session is emergency and 5GSM cause IE is missing or invalid, SMF rejects request with cause #31.
If PDU session is inactive, SMF rejects request with cause #43.
If AMF indicates DNN exemption but procedure is not exempt and no PS data off status, SMF rejects with cause #26.
If AMF indicates S-NSSAI and DNN exemption but procedure is not exempt and no PS data off status, SMF rejects with cause #67.
If AMF indicates S-NSSAI only exemption but procedure is not exempt and no PS data off status, SMF rejects with cause #69.
Extended protocol configuration options IE guards the condition of no PS data off status.
SMF rejection behavior involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains 5GSM cause IE.
